messages:
maria: Quick coordination — I opened a docs PR to unify our streaming + pagination examples across py/ts/go. Main goals: show resume tokens, clarify retry backoff, and fix a broken link to the pagination guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
kevin: Thanks — saw that. Do you want the SDK snippets to include the new `resume()` helper or keep it manual?
jamie: If we include `resume()` we should show both: the helper for simple cases and the manual path for custom backoff. People implementing serverside will need the manual example.
olivia: Agree. Also let's add a tiny diagram in the README showing request -> cache hit vs cold path. But for the snippet files themselves, can we keep them <=15 lines each? Docs lint complains about long examples.
alex: I pushed a small Go snippet suggestion to the PR comments: shows streaming with pagination and a jittered exponential retry. Code (Go):
```go
// simplified example - retry + resume token
for attempts := 0; attempts < 5; attempts++ {
    resp, err := client.StreamPaginated(ctx, "items", opts)
    if err != nil {
        time.Sleep(time.Duration(math.Pow(2, float64(attempts))) * 100 * time.Millisecond)
        continue
    }
    // process stream and persist resume token
    saveToken(resp.ResumeToken)
    break
}
```
maria: Nice, Alex. Can you also add a tiny inline comment about when to prefer prefix caching vs full request caching? That's been a FAQ.
docs-bot: Related issues: #212 (streaming backpressure), #324 (pagination link fix). Suggested label: docs/sdks.
jamie: One more ask: typescript example currently uses `for await (const chunk of stream)` — can we show explicit cancellation with AbortController? People trip over long-lived streams. Example idea:
```ts
const ac = new AbortController();
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 10_000); // cancel after 10s
for await (const chunk of client.streamPaginated({ signal: ac.signal })) {
  // handle chunk
}
```
kevin: I'll review the TS snippet for correctness and ensure we use the new `.resumeToken` field, not `cursor`.
olivia: I'll trim wording and run the docs linter after PR updates. Also will upload the small diagram as svg to /assets.
maria: Plan: kevin reviews TS, alex updates Go inline comment, jamie adds AbortController note and the manual resume example for Python, olivia runs linter + uploads diagram. I'll merge once CI + lint are green. Thanks team :rocket:
kevin: Quick checklist for PR description: mention backward compatibility (old `cursor` -> `resumeToken` mapping), list the files changed, and include the new short gif for aborting streams.
docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/ (expires in 3 days)
maria: Ok closing loop — will ping again if CI flags anything.
